name: RAG Engineer
tagline: Build retrieval systems that answer from real documents, with evidence.
description: A retrieval-first path: embeddings, chunking, vector and hybrid search, reranking, multimodal document retrieval, and rigorous retrieval evaluation. You still learn the transformer and LLM context needed to understand why retrieval behaves the way it does, but you skip vision, speech, and reinforcement learning depth.

phaseRationale.06-speech-and-audio: Audio retrieval is not part of the retrieval engineering core and would displace higher-value practice.
phaseRationale.09-reinforcement-learning: Retrieval quality is improved through evaluation and reranking, not policy optimization.
phaseRationale.15-autonomous-systems: Autonomous long-horizon systems are a different specialization from retrieval quality.
phaseRationale.03-deep-learning-core: You need model intuition, but you are not training neural networks from scratch.
phaseRationale.04-computer-vision: Only the vision-transformer occurrence is kept as optional depth; the rest is covered by multimodal retrieval when needed.
phaseRationale.10-llms-from-scratch: Understanding tokenization and context matters, but pre-training an LLM is not part of retrieval work.
phaseRationale.16-multi-agent-and-swarms: Retrieval usually feeds a single agent or a fixed pipeline; swarms are optional depth.

majorProjects: End-to-end RAG system over a real corpus
Hybrid retrieval with BM25 and dense embeddings plus a cross-encoder reranker
Vision-first document QA (ColPali-style) with retrieval evaluation
